Notice Of Motion And Motion To Enter Judgment Under Terms Of Stipulated Settlement
Off Calendar Aug-13-2026 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES:

No appearances. The Court adopts the tentative ruling as follows:

Plaintiff JPMorgan Chase Bank's motion to enter judgment under terms of stipulated settlement is granted.

The Bank has presented sufficient evidence showing that it is entitled to a judgment in its favor and against defendant Janebie Lazo in the amount of $7,527.82. No opposition filed. The court will sign the previously submitted proposed order and proposed judgment.

Proposed order and Judgment signed.

Visiting Judge: Harold E. Kahn; Clerk: M. Macadangdang; Not Reported. (302/HEK)
